root_cause_analysis.standard_mode_bottleneck: Gemini sequential chain. With standard_prop_stride=5 → 360 frames → 24 windows × 11.3s = 271s. The tracking speedup (17 min → 3.4 min) is wasted because Gemini is now the sole bottleneck. M2 with frame_stride=6 had 300 frames → 20 windows → 230s Gemini (faster despite same rate because fewer windows). prop_stride=5 creates MORE windows than frame_stride=6 alone.
root_cause_analysis.fast_mode_path_to_22_min: 4.5 min full-fixture projection. To hit ≤2.2 min: need K=4 parallel tracking segments. But K=4 tracking on single GPU serializes kernels (M3 lesson) → no gain. Alternative: increase prop_stride to 32+ (≤22 SAM2 frames → ≤2 Gemini windows → ~1 min tracking + 0.5 min analyze = 1.5 min). Risk: very sparse temporal resolution.
root_cause_analysis.correct_standard_mode_target: prop_stride=1 (no change from M2) is already optimal for standard mode. The 22 min full-fixture target is only achievable with K=4 upscale+analyze parallelism (segment_runner S9) since tracking cannot be parallelized on single GPU.

code_fixes_discovered.description: When prop_stride > 1, frame_stride must be forced to 1. Otherwise LCM(prop_stride, frame_stride) determines actual sampling rate. Example: prop_stride=5 + frame_stride=6 = LCM(30) = every 30th real frame = 2 fps instead of 12 fps.
